description: This file defines the ModuleFilterConfig class, which implements the javax.servlet.FilterConfig interface. It provides an encapsulation of filter configuration details used in the openmrs module web filtering system, including factory methods and property accessors.

classes.name: ModuleFilterConfig
classes.description: Implementation of the FilterConfig interface, encapsulating filter definition and servlet context details.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ModuleFilterConfig with specified filter definition and servlet context.

methods.name: getFilterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter from the filter definition.

methods.name: getInitParameter
methods.description: Retrieves an initialization parameter by name from the filter definition.

methods.name: getInitParameterNames
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of all initialization parameter names.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Getter for the filter definition object.

methods.name: setFilterDefinition
methods.description: Setter for the filter definition object.
